reasons: § 12.4 binds Customer with a 24-month post-term, any-product, any-territory non-compete that expressly bars acquisitions — this fails the fallback on period, scope and carve-outs and sits in walk-away territory, so a deviation finding is correct.

Deleting § 12.4 in full is the minimal edit that reaches the preferred position and also cures the direct contradiction with § 12.3, which confirms Customer gave no non-compete or exclusivity commitment.
Comment is accurate, concise, correctly attributed to the playbook, and offers the narrowed fallback (named product, term only, 12 months, carve-outs) as a negotiation option.
Deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and no open-ended compete restriction on Customer survives.
